data.explanation: Raising the sourcing cap from 0.03 to 0.04 USDZ moves 0.50 USDZ from the support refund budget to sourcing, which keeps data buying running at 0.01 USDZ margin per call. Refunds still have 3.50 USDZ, well above the 0.60 USDZ floor, and the licence fee is untouched. This needs your approval because the cap rises 33%, above the 25% limit. Pausing sourcing (E) was not chosen because it would lose about 6.00 USDZ of sales per hour while paused.

rejected.why: Feed B asks 0.05 USDZ, which is above both the 0.03 USDZ cap and the 0.04 USDZ margin limit, so it would leave zero margin.
Taking 0.50 USDZ from treasury leaves 5.50 USDZ against the 5.72 USDZ needed for licence invoice LIC-2026-11 due 2026-10-31.
Selling at 0.06 USDZ does nothing on its own because the cap stays at 0.03 USDZ and the 0.04 USDZ purchase is still refused.
Pausing sourcing loses about 6.00 USDZ of sales per hour, which is far worse than the cost of a small cap increase.
